title: Kalimat ash-Shahadah
intro: The first pillar of Islam: bearing witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad is His Messenger.

learn.label: Kalimat ash-Shahadah
learn.ar: أَشْهَدُ أَنْ لَا إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا اللَّهُ وَأَشْهَدُ أَنَّ مُحَمَّدًا عَبْدُهُ وَرَسُولُهُ
learn.tr: Ash-hadu an laa ilaaha illallaah, wa ash-hadu anna Muhammadan ‘abduhu wa rasooluh.
learn.en: I bear witness that there is no god but Allah, and I bear witness that Muhammad is His servant and Messenger.

learn.title: 📖 In the Qur’an
learn.html: Allah bears witness that there is no god but Him – and so do the angels and those with knowledge – maintaining justice. There is no god but Him, the Almighty, the All-Wise. <small>(Qur’an, Ali ‘Imran 3:18)</small>
The first pillar of Islam is bearing witness that there is no god but Allah and that Muhammad (SAW) is His Messenger. The Kalimat ash-Shahadah is the foundation of a Muslim’s faith and has two parts.

learn.text: 1. There is no god but Allah

learn.html: The first part means that in all that exists there is no one worthy of worship except Allah, the Most High. By it we reject the worship of angels, prophets, chosen people, trees, the sun, the moon, stones and graves – because Allah created all of them. We also confirm that everything on earth, living and not living, was created and bears witness to Allah’s oneness. So only Allah deserves worship, and the whole universe submits to Him.
Saying “there is no god but Allah” is the key to entering Islam and the main mark of a believer: in it is the decision to obey Allah, worship only Him and turn away from worshipping anything else.

items: Bearing witness that Allah sent His last Messenger, Muhammad (SAW), with the truth – the Qur’an – to bring good news and warn all of humanity. <small>(Qur’an, Saba’ 34:28)</small>
Believing that everything Muhammad (SAW) said, did and told us is true, because it is revelation from Allah – he does not speak from his own desire. <small>(Qur’an, An-Najm 53:3–4)</small>
Muhammad (SAW) conveyed from Allah, and our duty is to obey what he commanded and avoid what he forbade. <small>(Qur’an, Al-Hashr 59:7)</small>

learn.title: ⭐ Remember
learn.html: All Muslims in the world believe the truths of the Shahadah, and every act of worship we do confirms: there is no god but Allah, and Muhammad is His Messenger.

practice.title: Which part of the Shahadah?
practice.prompt: Is this about the first part or the second part?

items.text: We do not worship the sun, stones or graves
He brought the Qur’an to all people
He did not speak from his own desire

questions.q: How many parts does the Kalimat ash-Shahadah have?
What does the first part mean?
options: No one is worthy of worship except Allah

questions.q: What is the key to entering Islam?
options: Saying there is no god but Allah

questions.q: With what did Allah send Muhammad (SAW)?
What is our duty toward what the Prophet (SAW) commanded?

practice.title: Talk and tasks
prompts: 🤲 Talk with your muallim: by our worship we confirm “there is no god but Allah and Muhammad is His Messenger” – how are worship and the Shahadah connected?
🖊️ Write the Arabic text of the Shahadah on a big sheet, copying it from a calligraphy panel (levha).
🌿 How does nature – plants, animals, everything around us – bear witness to Allah’s oneness?
💭 Write words or sentences that remind you of tawhid – the oneness of Allah.
